items.name: Sephiria
items.sub: TEAM HORAY · Multiplayer, Action Roguelike, Inventory Management
items.desc: Save Bunnyville from a doomed fate: a top-down action/RPG roguelite from the makers of Dungreed. Explore the depths of the tower, collect and upgrade artifacts, and defeat hordes of demons to keep your village safe.

items.name: Invokyr
items.desc: A co-op survival horror game about a cursed board game. Play in a group of 6 players. Roll the dice, survive the horrors that are summoned, and beat the Gamemaster to win your freedom.

items.name: Escape From Duckov
items.desc: Escape from Duckov is a PVE indie survival RPG — in a duck's world!. Scavenge for resources, build your hideout, and upgrade your gear in the world of Duckov. Start from nothing and rise to the top. Outwit hostile ducks, survive, or make it out alive.

items.name: Happy Wheels
items.desc: Choose your inadequately prepared racer, and disregard severe consequences in your desperate pursuit of short-lived victory.

items.name: The Jackbox Party Pack 12
items.desc: Escape the ordinary with The Jackbox Party Pack 12! Embark on a party adventure with goofy greetings in We Forgot a Card, wild image warping in Hyperface, absurd arguments in Debate and Switch, team-based fact battles in Idol Factions, and mind-melding friendship in MegaPals.

items.sub: Metal Head Games · RPG, Story Rich, Pixel Graphics

Investigate two conspiracies from the inside, gather evidence, and outsmart a system designed to silence you. Make friends (or foes) with fellow inmates and with their help, break out of prison.

items.name: No More Room in Hell 2
items.sub: Torn Banner Studios · Early Access, Zombies, Multiplayer
items.desc: No More Room in Hell 2 is an intense 8 player zombie shooter. Overcome the endless undead. Avoid infection. Survive hell together.

items.name: Magical Girl ER
items.desc: A medical simulation where you examine and treat magical girls injured in kaiju disasters. With limited hospital beds and stamina, decide who to accept, who to refuse, and which treatment to choose.

items.name: Stackade
items.desc: Tower defense where your towers fall as blocks. Drag each piece onto the board, wall in your HQ and turn the gaps into kill zones. Every enemy comes at you its own way, bosses test your build, and between waves the Armory never has enough money for everything you want.

items.name: Apothecary Grounds
items.sub: Origins Media · Adventure, Free To Play
items.desc: Explore a seemingly empty land where a lonely graveyard is your only familiar landmark. Gather the items needed to unlock a sealed crypt, uncover the secrets beyond its door, evade the relentless Apothecary who guards the grounds, and unravel the mystery buried beneath them.

items.name: Rend
items.desc: A shooter primarily focused on constantly aiming at various difficulties.

items.name: Boomsday
items.desc: Hordes of adorable animals and toys want you dead. Boomsday is a fast-paced top-down horde survival shooter. Mow down endless swarms, loot powerful weapons, stack game-breaking perks, and survive massive bosses every 10 waves. Solo or up to 8-player cross-play co-op or 2 on the couch.

items.name: Talaire
items.desc: Astronauts stranded on the moon have gone a little crazy. Race office chairs, complete repair mini-games, and sabotage your rivals to win the heart of the Moon Princess: a rock with a wig. They're taking this very seriously.
